Subject: Juniver Distribution - New Submission

Hi Tomas,

Thanks for the submission on Juniver Distribution! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward.

I have a few questions before I can finalize the quote:

- Can you confirm the primary operations at the location and any specialized storage or distribution activities?
- Are there any fire suppression or security systems in place beyond what's noted in the application?
- The loss runs show a couple of claims in 2023—can you provide additional details on the causes and any corrective actions taken?

Once I have these details, I'll work up a competitive quote for you.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
